concept: A stock market graph line plummeting downward in sharp, jagged red strokes against a dark background, morphing midway into flames and ashes—the pixels shifting from geometric financial abstraction to organic chaos. Bold silhouettes of falling figures and collapsing structures embedded in the declining line. High contrast, stark composition, dystopian corporate mood.
explanation: Today's headlines oscillate between economic collapse, political violence, and systemic failure across multiple domains—markets cratering, fires destroying lives, assassination plots, gender-based murders, and a toxic geopolitical climate. While Anthropic's mathematical breakthrough offers a glimmer of intellectual progress, it's overwhelmed by the weight of financial instability, human cruelty, and institutional breakdown. The falling market line became a visual anchor for the broader sense of systems coming apart.

headlines.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
headlines.summary: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

headlines.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
headlines.summary: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

headlines.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
headlines.summary: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

headlines.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
headlines.summary: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

headlines.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
headlines.summary: Trump's comments came after Russia launched "biggest attacks this year" against Ukraine.

headlines.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest
headlines.summary: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take some time.

headlines.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
headlines.summary: A judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed last year over "allegations of a sexual nature".

headlines.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
headlines.summary: Plans to shutter the troubled facility date back to 2019, when the city council first voted to close it but delays arose over where to place inmates.

headlines.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
headlines.summary: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

headlines.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
headlines.summary: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

headlines.title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader
headlines.summary: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.

headlines.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
headlines.summary: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent... violence" against women and children.
